headline: Mortgage borrowers face fix-term dilemma amid uncertainty
caption: ANZ economists are weighing in on one of the biggest decisions facing homeowners right now—how long to fix your mortgage for. With short-term rates cheaper but longer terms offering peace of mind, it's worth understanding your options. If you're thinking about refinancing or locking in a rate, let's chat about what makes sense for your situation! 🏡
original_title: ANZ NZ economists say mortgage borrowers face a quandary over how long to fix for
